controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate an access control policy that addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and procedures to facilitate the implementation of the access control policy and the associated access controls.
controls.supplemental_guidance: FedRAMP requires CSPs to address access control for all personnel accessing federal information.
assessment_objectives: Verify access control policy and procedures are documented and disseminated

controls.title: Account Management
controls.description: Define and document the types of accounts allowed and specifically prohibited for use within the system; assign account managers; require prerequisites and criteria for group and role membership; specify authorized users, group and role membership, and access authorizations and other attributes for each account; require approvals for requests to create accounts.
controls.supplemental_guidance: FedRAMP requires monthly review of accounts for Moderate and High baselines.
assessment_objectives: Verify account management procedures are implemented

controls.title: Access Enforcement
controls.description: Enforce approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources in accordance with applicable access control policies.
assessment_objectives: Verify access enforcement mechanisms are in place

controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement
controls.description: Enforce approved authorizations for controlling the flow of information within the system and between connected systems based on information flow control policies.
assessment_objectives: Verify information flow controls are enforced

controls.title: Separation of Duties
controls.description: Identify and document duties of individuals requiring separation; and define system access authorizations to support separation of duties.
assessment_objectives: Verify separation of duties is documented and enforced

controls.title: Least Privilege
controls.description: Employ the principle of least privilege, allowing only authorized accesses for users (or processes acting on behalf of users) that are necessary to accomplish assigned organizational tasks.
assessment_objectives: Verify least privilege is implemented

controls.title: Unsuccessful Logon Attempts
controls.description: Enforce a limit of consecutive invalid logon attempts by a user during a specified time period; and automatically lock the account or delay next logon prompt when the maximum number of unsuccessful attempts is exceeded.
controls.supplemental_guidance: FedRAMP requires no more than three consecutive invalid logon attempts within 15 minutes for Moderate/High.
assessment_objectives: Verify account lockout is configured per FedRAMP parameters

controls.title: System Use Notification
controls.description: Display an approved system use notification message or banner before granting access to the system that provides privacy and security notices.
controls.supplemental_guidance: FedRAMP requires the banner to include specific language about monitoring and consent.
assessment_objectives: Verify login banners display required notices

controls.title: Remote Access
controls.description: Establish and document usage restrictions, configuration/connection requirements, and implementation guidance for each type of remote access allowed; and authorize each type of remote access to the system prior to allowing such connections.
assessment_objectives: Verify remote access is authorized and controlled

controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate an awareness and training policy and procedures to facilitate the implementation of the security awareness and training policy.
assessment_objectives: Verify training policy and procedures exist

controls.title: Literacy Training and Awareness
controls.description: Provide security and privacy literacy training to system users including awareness of cyber threats, recognizing social engineering attacks, and reporting suspicious activity.
controls.supplemental_guidance: FedRAMP requires annual security awareness training with phishing exercises.
assessment_objectives: Verify security awareness training is conducted annually

controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate an audit and accountability policy that addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance.
assessment_objectives: Verify audit policy and procedures are documented

controls.title: Event Logging
controls.description: Identify the types of events that the system is capable of logging in support of the audit function; coordinate the event logging function with other organizational entities requiring audit-related information; specify event types for logging within the system; provide a rationale for why the event types selected for logging are deemed to be adequate.
controls.supplemental_guidance: FedRAMP requires logging of successful and unsuccessful logon attempts, account management events, object access, policy changes, and privilege functions.
assessment_objectives: Verify auditable events are identified and logged

controls.title: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting
controls.description: Review and analyze system audit records for indications of inappropriate or unusual activity and report findings to designated organizational officials; adjust the level of audit record review, analysis, and reporting when there is a change in risk.
controls.supplemental_guidance: FedRAMP Moderate/High requires weekly review of audit records.
assessment_objectives: Verify audit records are reviewed and analyzed regularly

controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate a security assessment and authorization policy and procedures.
assessment_objectives: Verify assessment and authorization policy exists

controls.title: Control Assessments
controls.description: Select an assessor or assessment team to conduct security and privacy control assessments; develop a control assessment plan; ensure assessors have independence; assess controls to determine extent to which they are implemented correctly, operating as intended, and producing the desired outcome.
controls.supplemental_guidance: FedRAMP requires assessment by an accredited 3PAO.
assessment_objectives: Verify control assessments are conducted by 3PAO

controls.title: Continuous Monitoring
controls.description: Develop a system-level continuous monitoring strategy and implement continuous monitoring in accordance with the organization-level and system-level continuous monitoring strategies.
controls.supplemental_guidance: FedRAMP ConMon requirements include monthly OS/database/web app scanning and annual penetration testing.
assessment_objectives: Verify continuous monitoring strategy is implemented per FedRAMP ConMon guide

controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate a configuration management policy and procedures.
assessment_objectives: Verify configuration management policy is documented

controls.title: Baseline Configuration
controls.description: Develop, document, and maintain a current baseline configuration of the system under configuration control.
assessment_objectives: Verify baseline configuration is documented and maintained

controls.title: Configuration Settings
controls.description: Establish and document configuration settings for components employed within the system that reflect the most restrictive mode consistent with operational requirements using organizationally-approved security configuration checklists.
controls.supplemental_guidance: FedRAMP requires use of DISA STIGs, CIS Benchmarks, or vendor hardening guides.
assessment_objectives: Verify hardened configuration settings are applied

controls.title: System Component Inventory
controls.description: Develop and document an inventory of system components that accurately reflects the system; is consistent with the authorization boundary; is at a level of granularity deemed necessary for tracking and reporting; and includes information deemed necessary for component accountability.
assessment_objectives: Verify system component inventory is current and complete

controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate a contingency planning policy and procedures.
assessment_objectives: Verify contingency planning policy is documented

controls.title: Contingency Plan
controls.description: Develop a contingency plan for the system that identifies essential mission and business functions and associated contingency requirements; provides recovery objectives, restoration priorities, and metrics; identifies roles, responsibilities, and assigned individuals with contact information.
assessment_objectives: Verify contingency plan is developed and current

controls.title: System Backup
controls.description: Conduct backups of user-level information, system-level information, and system documentation at a frequency consistent with recovery time and recovery point objectives; protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of backup information.
controls.supplemental_guidance: FedRAMP requires daily incremental and weekly full backups for Moderate/High.
assessment_objectives: Verify backup processes meet FedRAMP frequency requirements

controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate an identification and authentication policy and procedures.
assessment_objectives: Verify I&A policy is documented

controls.title: Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users)
controls.description: Uniquely identify and authenticate organizational users, and associate that unique identification with processes acting on behalf of those users.
controls.supplemental_guidance: FedRAMP requires MFA for all privileged and non-privileged network access at Moderate/High.
assessment_objectives: Verify unique identification and MFA per FedRAMP requirements

controls.title: Authenticator Management
controls.description: Manage system authenticators by verifying the identity of the individual, group, role, service, or device receiving the authenticator; establishing initial authenticator content; ensuring authenticators have sufficient strength of mechanism; establishing and implementing administrative procedures for initial authenticator distribution, for lost/compromised or damaged authenticators, and for revoking authenticators.
controls.supplemental_guidance: FedRAMP requires FIPS 140-2 validated cryptographic modules for authenticator protection.
assessment_objectives: Verify authenticator management procedures

controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate an incident response policy and procedures.
assessment_objectives: Verify incident response policy is documented

controls.title: Incident Handling
controls.description: Implement an incident handling capability for incidents that is consistent with the incident response plan and includes preparation, detection and analysis, containment, eradication, and recovery.
controls.supplemental_guidance: FedRAMP requires reporting incidents to US-CERT within specified timeframes based on incident category.
assessment_objectives: Verify incident handling capability includes all phases

controls.title: Incident Reporting
controls.description: Require personnel to report suspected incidents to the organizational incident response capability within specified time period; and report incident information to designated authorities.
controls.supplemental_guidance: FedRAMP requires reporting to US-CERT within 1 hour for high-impact incidents.
assessment_objectives: Verify incident reporting procedures and timeframes

controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate a physical and environmental protection policy and procedures.
assessment_objectives: Verify physical security policy is documented

controls.title: Physical Access Authorizations
controls.description: Develop, approve, and maintain a list of individuals with authorized access to the facility where the system resides; issue authorization credentials for facility access; review the access list and authorization credentials at a defined frequency.
assessment_objectives: Verify physical access authorization lists are maintained

controls.title: System Security and Privacy Plans
controls.description: Develop security and privacy plans for the system that are consistent with the organization's enterprise architecture; explicitly define the constituent system components; describe the operational context of the system in terms of mission and business processes; identify the individuals that fulfill system roles and responsibilities.
controls.supplemental_guidance: FedRAMP SSP must follow the FedRAMP SSP template.
assessment_objectives: Verify SSP is developed per FedRAMP template requirements

controls.title: Vulnerability Monitoring and Scanning
controls.description: Monitor and scan for vulnerabilities in the system and hosted applications at a defined frequency and when new vulnerabilities potentially affecting the system are identified; employ vulnerability monitoring tools and techniques that facilitate interoperability and automate parts of the vulnerability management process.
controls.supplemental_guidance: FedRAMP requires monthly OS and database scans, monthly web application scans, and annual penetration testing. High and critical findings must be remediated within 30 days.
assessment_objectives: Verify vulnerability scanning meets FedRAMP frequency requirements

controls.title: External System Services
controls.description: Require that providers of external system services comply with organizational security requirements and employ controls in accordance with applicable federal laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines.
controls.supplemental_guidance: FedRAMP requires that all external services used by the CSP be FedRAMP authorized or document the risks of non-FedRAMP services.
assessment_objectives: Verify external services are FedRAMP authorized or risk-documented

controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate a system and communications protection policy and procedures.
assessment_objectives: Verify SC policy is documented

controls.title: Boundary Protection
controls.description: Monitor and control communications at the external managed interfaces to the system and at key internal managed interfaces within the system; implement subnetworks for publicly accessible system components that are physically or logically separated from internal organizational networks; and connect to external networks or systems only through managed interfaces.
assessment_objectives: Verify boundary protections at managed interfaces

controls.title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
controls.description: Protect the confidentiality and integrity of transmitted information.
controls.supplemental_guidance: FedRAMP requires FIPS-validated encryption (TLS 1.2 minimum) for data in transit.
assessment_objectives: Verify FIPS-validated encryption for data in transit

controls.title: Cryptographic Protection
controls.description: Determine the cryptographic uses and type of cryptography required for each use in accordance with applicable federal laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines; and implement the required cryptographic protections using cryptographic modules that comply with applicable federal laws.
controls.supplemental_guidance: FedRAMP requires FIPS 140-2 validated cryptographic modules.
assessment_objectives: Verify FIPS 140-2 validated modules are used

controls.title: Protection of Information at Rest
controls.description: Protect the confidentiality and integrity of information at rest.
controls.supplemental_guidance: FedRAMP requires encryption of federal data at rest using FIPS-validated cryptography.
assessment_objectives: Verify data at rest is encrypted with FIPS-validated cryptography

controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate a system and information integrity policy and procedures.
assessment_objectives: Verify SI policy is documented

controls.title: Flaw Remediation
controls.description: Identify, report, and correct system flaws; test software and firmware updates related to flaw remediation for effectiveness and potential side effects before installation; install security-relevant software and firmware updates within the time period directed by an authoritative source.
controls.supplemental_guidance: FedRAMP requires high vulnerabilities remediated within 30 days, moderate within 90 days.
assessment_objectives: Verify flaw remediation meets FedRAMP timeframes

controls.title: Malicious Code Protection
controls.description: Implement malicious code protection mechanisms at system entry and exit points to detect and eradicate malicious code; update malicious code protection mechanisms whenever new releases are available; configure malicious code protection mechanisms to perform periodic scans and real-time scans of files from external sources.
assessment_objectives: Verify malware protection is deployed and current

controls.title: System Monitoring
controls.description: Monitor the system to detect attacks and indicators of potential attacks, unauthorized local, network, and remote connections; identify unauthorized use of the system through monitoring.
controls.supplemental_guidance: FedRAMP requires real-time alerting for Moderate/High baselines.
assessment_objectives: Verify system monitoring and alerting capabilities
